// R-Type
    memory[0] = 32'b00000_00011_0000100010000110000000; // ADD  R1 = R2 + R3 
    memory[1] = 32'b00001_00011_0000100010000110000000; // SUB  R1 = R2 - R3
    memory[2] = 32'b00010000110000100010000110000000; // OR   R1 = R2 | R3
    memory[3] = 32'b00011000110000100010000110000000; // NOR  R1 = ~(R2|R3)
    memory[4] = 32'b00100000110000100010000110000000; // AND  R1 = R2 & R3
    memory[5] = 32'b00000000000000000000000000000000; // NOP

// I-Type
    memory[0] = 32'b00101_00011_00001_00010_000000000101; // ADDI R1 = R2 + 5
    memory[1] = 32'b00110_00011_00001_00010_000000001111; // ORI  R1 = R2 | 0xF
    memory[2] = 32'b00111_00011_00001_00010_000000001111; // NORI R1 = ~(R2 | 0xF)
    memory[3] = 32'b01000_00011_00001_00010_000000001111; // ANDI R1 = R2 & 0xF
    memory[4] = 32'b00000000000000000000000000000000; // NOP

// Memory Instructions
    memory[0] = 32'b01001_11100_00100_00010_000000000000; // LW R4, 107(R0)
    memory[1] = 32'b01010_00000_00101_00100_000000000000; // SW R5, 0(R4)
    memory[2] = 32'b00000000000000000000000000000000; // NOP

// Jump and Control flow
    memory[0] = 32'b01011_00000_0000000000000000000010; // J +2
    memory[1] = 32'b00000000000000000000000000000000; // skipped
    memory[2] = 32'b01100000000000000000000000000011; // CALL
    memory[5] = 32'b01101_00000_00000_01000_000000000000; // JR R1

// Predicated Execution
    memory[0] = 32'b00000_00101_00001_00010_00011_0000000; // does not execute
    memory[1] = 32'b00000_00000_00001_00001_00010_0000000; // shows that it hasnt executed
